requirement_text.ISS-0216: Letflow.Api.Pagination.decode_cursor/4 trusts its caller-supplied prefix with no non-empty guard, a real bypass path once REQ-072-onward endpoints call it. check_prefix/2 (lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex) uses a size guard (byte_size(decoded) >= byte_size(prefix) and String.starts_with?(decoded, prefix)) that trivially passes if prefix is an empty string, since every decoded cursor starts with the empty string -- an empty prefix defeats the cross-endpoint isolation this parameter exists to provide. Filed 2026-08-21 as unreachable-but-real-risk (REQ-072 routing layer was pending); NOW LIVE -- confirmed 2026-08-26 that real route handlers (lib/letflow/routers/audit.ex, tasks.ex, instances.ex, routers/tenants.ex, routers/identity.ex, definitions.ex) already call decode_cursor/4 with hardcoded non-empty module-attribute prefixes. The guard itself is still missing.

result.summary:
Implemented lib/letflow/design/iss0216-pagination-prefix-guard.md §2.1/§2.2/§3 exactly. Added a new leading check_prefix/2 function-head clause `defp check_prefix(_decoded, "")` above the existing clause, which raises ArgumentError with a message naming decode_cursor/4 (the public entry point), the precondition (prefix must be a non-empty hardcoded per-endpoint literal, never request/query/path-derived), why it matters (defeats cross-endpoint cursor isolation per ISS-0216, since String.starts_with?(decoded, "") always matches), and a pointer to the new moduledoc INV-9. The existing check_prefix/2 clause (size/starts_with? logic) is byte-for-byte unchanged, now second in dispatch order. check_prefix/2's own @spec (:ok | {:error, :wrong_endpoint}) and decode_cursor/4's @spec/body/with-chain are all unchanged, matching §2.2's explicit no-signature-change decision (raise isn't part of a @spec return type). Added the INV-9 moduledoc paragraph (module @moduledoc, after INV-8) and the prefix-precondition paragraph on decode_cursor/4's own @doc, both using the exact wording §3 specifies. No route handler or test file touched -- only lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex changed (git diff --stat confirms: 1 file changed, 39 insertions).

mix format lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex: ran clean, no diff. mix format --check-formatted lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex: passed silently (exit 0). mix compile --warnings-as-errors: 'Compiling 3 files (.ex)', no warnings, exit 0. Ran the existing test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs suite as a non-regression sanity check (not a new-test-writing step, per task.description's explicit 'do not touch ... tests'): 'Finished in 0.1 seconds ... Result: 38 passed', 0 failures -- confirms the new leading clause does not change behavior for any non-empty prefix.

No empty-prefix test exists yet in the suite (expected -- that's TEST-DESIGNER's job next per the design's §4). No @spec changed, no moduledoc invariant renumbered, no scope expansion beyond §2.1/§2.2/§3 (did not guard non-binary prefix per §5's explicit out-of-scope note).
